description: Finds verses containing ALL the given words in one edition. Words match as substrings, so a stem finds its forms ("forgiv" finds forgive, forgiven, forgiveness). Put a phrase in double quotes to match it exactly. Search an edition in the language of the words, e.g. osen or kjv for English, osnb/osnn for Norwegian, sblgnt/tanach for Greek/Hebrew spellings.

book.description: Limit to one book, by name or abbreviation in any language, e.g. "John", "Joh" or "Sal". Default: the whole Bible.

edition.description: Edition to search, in the language of the words: osnb (Norwegian Bokmål), osnn (Norwegian Nynorsk), osen (English), oses (Spanish), sblgnt (Greek New Testament), tanach (Hebrew Old Testament), kjv (King James Version, English), web (World English Bible), bsb (Berean Standard Bible, English), asv (American Standard Version, English), luther_1912 (Luther 1912, German), segond_1910 (Louis Segond 1910, French), rv_1909 (Reina-Valera 1909, Spanish), akjv (American King James Version, English), albanian (Albanian Bible), bungo (Bungo-yaku, classical Japanese), cadman (Cadman 1926, Vietnamese), chinese_union_simp (Chinese Union Version, simplified), chinese_union_trad (Chinese Union Version, traditional), cpdv (Catholic Public Domain Version, English), dbt (Darby Translation, English), diodati (Diodati, Italian), drb (Douay-Rheims (Challoner), English), elberfelder_1905 (Elberfelder 1905, German), elberfelder_1871 (Elberfelder 1871, German), dnb30 (Bibelselskapet 1930, Norwegian Bokmål), erv (English Revised Version), finn (Finnish 1776), geneva (Geneva Bible, English), hcv (Haitian Creole Bible (1985)), he_modern (Modern Hebrew Bible (Delitzsch NT)), jps (JPS Tanakh 1917, English), kougo (Kougo-yaku 1954/55, Japanese), lv_gluck_8 (Glück Bible, Latvian), martin (Martin 1744, French), opt (Old Persian Version, Persian), rv_1858 (Reina-Valera 1858 New Testament, Spanish), sagradas (Sagradas Escrituras 1569, Spanish), slt (Smith's Literal Translation, English), swahili (Swahili New Testament), synodal (Synodal Translation 1876, Russian), tagab (Ang Biblia 1905, Tagalog), wbt (Webster Bible 1833, English), weymouth (Weymouth New Testament 1903, English), ylt (Young's Literal Translation, English), bn_irv (Indian Revised Version, Bengali), gu_irv (Indian Revised Version, Gujarati), irv (Indian Revised Version, Hindi), ha_con (Open Hausa Contemporary Bible), ha_lit (Litafi Mai-tsarki, Hausa New Testament), kn_irv (Indian Revised Version, Kannada), mr_irv (Indian Revised Version, Marathi), pa_irv (Indian Revised Version, Punjabi), ta_irv (Indian Revised Version, Tamil), te_irv (Indian Revised Version, Telugu), coverdale (Coverdale Bible 1535, English). Default: osen.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

mapping.description: Verse numbering to give the verse references in: a mapping id from list_verse_mappings, e.g. "english_kj" (King James) or "dnb2024_nb", or a short name such as "kjv". Default: osnb, the site's own numbering.

offset.description: How many verses to skip, for the next page: pass the offset the previous answer names. Default: 0.

query.description: Words to find, e.g. `forgiv sins` or `"love one another"`.

testament.description: Limit to the Old (OT) or New (NT) Testament. Ignored when book is given. Default: both.

name: search_bible
title: Search the Bible text
